code:
name: Expo CI/CD

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: expo/expo-github-action@v8
        with:
          eas-version: latest
          expo-cache: true
      - run: eas build --platform ios --non-interactive
      - run: eas submit -p ios --latest
